title: Episode About the Expansion of the Khalsa Panth

blocks.text: The Guru sent letters to the sangat, asking them to come and receive the khande-di-pahul. (6)
Whoever drank the pahul was to become filled with new radiance and turn fearlessly against tyranny. (7)
Those who accepted the Guru’s command in Majha were blessed, and the Khalsa Panth emerged while the Satguru looked upon it with deep joy. (8–9)
